p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): Check that a platform is not flagged by regulators before trusting money
p.espaces.rg_note: A site should open in its own language: use your browser's translation, or use the "UnderstaDocument" document. When making a major decision, consult with a professional in that country.

p.espaces.cu_d4: Certificate of Origin (to obtain reduced tax)
p.espaces.cu_d5: ORI number (for import or export transactions in the European Union)
p.espaces.cu_d6: Depending on the product: Health or Pesticide Certificate, License, CE Standards
p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: Buyer takes care of everything from seller’s factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: Seller delivers the goods to the buyer’s carrier after paying export duties.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: Seller loads goods into container; then, risk and cost are borne by buyer.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: The seller bears the cost of freight and insurance until the goods arrive at the port.
p.espaces.cu_i5: WUP: Seller delivers goods to destination, Buyer pays import duty.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: The seller pays everything including import duties.
p.espaces.cu_ban: Prohibited or regulated everywhere: Weapons, drugs, counterfeit goods, protected species (CITS), some drugs. Such lists are rejected and may be reported (ED).

Understand the document
p.papier.sub: Take a picture of a letter, medicine, form or symbol and read it in your language.
p.papier.private: The image will be saved on your phone. Only the read text will be sent to the free translation service.
p.papier.first: First time for this language: The phone downloads its read data (a few MB).
p.papier.none: No text found. Take the photo again, softer and with more light.
p.papier.e_lib: Could not initiate reading: Internet required for the first time. Try again after connecting.
p.papier.e_read: Reading failed. Take the photo again.
p.papier.e_tr: Translation failed (relative or day limit). Try again.
p.papier.warn: Machine Translation: Check an important document (court, health, finance, residence permit) with someone or an organization you trust. Handwriting is usually misread.
